headline: 📰 LATEST NEWS
source: Telangana Today / Deccan Chronicle / The Hindu
bullets_en: Hyderabad water supply: HMWSSB plans 10 MGD Manjeera cut from December.
MLA Orders Resurvey of Land for Nallavelli Farmers.
Centre has failed to strengthen education sector, claims Hariprasad.
Albania protests continue for sixth straight day demanding Prime Minister’s resignation.
Haveri University circular on compulsory attendance for Ayudha Puja draws protest.
bullets_ur: Hyderabad mein paani ki rasad: HMWSSB ka December se Manjeera supply mein 10 MGD kami ka mansooba.
MLA ne Nallavelli ke kisano ke liye zameen ke dobarah survey ka hukum de diya.
Markaz taleemi shobay ko mustahkam karne mein nakam raha, Hariprasad ka dawa.
Albania mein Wazir-e-Azam ke isteefay ke mutalbay par musalsal chhatay roz bhi ehtijaj jari.
Ayudha Puja par lazmi hazri ke Haveri University ke circular par ehtijaj shuru.
